title: backlog.md says every CI job is manual, but kb-tests-windows starts on its own for tool changes
goal: kb/_self/backlog.md's red-pipeline paragraph and the GATE_JOBS comment in _tools/ql_deliver.py no longer say every job in .gitlab-ci.yml is manual: they say the gate jobs and kb-tests-windows start on their own with allow_failure: true, so the pipeline's status still says success whatever they did, and that is why it is read by its jobs.

run: import pathlib,sys; t=pathlib.Path('kb/_self/backlog.md').read_text(encoding='utf-8')+pathlib.Path('_tools/ql_deliver.py').read_text(encoding='utf-8'); sys.exit(1 if 'is manual with' in t else 0)
